CERTIFICATE OF COMPLETION OF WORK
This is to certify that the work of “Highway Tunnel — West Bengal Pkg-120” (tunnels),
awarded to M/s National Infrastructure Corp. Ltd. (GSTIN 19NAICC4417O1Z1, PAN
NAICC4417O) , has been completed in all respects on 20 May 2023 at a gross executed value
of Rs. 7466.00 Lakh (Rupees 74.66 Crore Only).
On joint measurement and final inspection, the executed quantities were found in order and
the workmanship conforming to the technical specifications forming part of the contract.
The work was supervised on the contractor's side by Rahul Menon. This certificate is issued for
record and for submission with future tenders wherever the contractor is required to establish
past performance.
Executive Engineer
Irrigation & Waterways Dept, Govt of West Bengal
